name: regions_by_revenue
question: which regions are our biggest by revenue?
reference_sql: SELECT lower(c.region) AS region, SUM(oi.qty * oi.price) AS revenue
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
reading: The regional revenue question with the ordering made part of the answer. Grouping on the raw column reports west three times and gets the ranking wrong as well as the rows.
